title: Template
description: Read shape for system-curated starter templates. Spec §10 / Plan §18.3. System-owned in V1 — no user_id FK. User-authored templates are V2.

slug.description: Stable lowercase-kebab identifier. Workspace.template_slug references this.

description.description: Short marketing line shown under the template name on the card.

problem_statement.description: Seed text inserted into the workspace form when the user picks this template.

sort_order.description: Lower values appear first on the dashboard strip.

active.description: Soft-disable flag — inactive templates are hidden from GET /templates but kept for historical Workspace.template_slug references.
